items.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If destroyed, the tile creature regains all its hit points and becomes active again in 24 hours unless at least half its tiles are collected and kept separate from the rest of the creature's tiles.

items.name: Narrow Dodge
entries: When targeted by a melee attack, the tile creature can take a reaction to turn its narrowest aspect toward the attacker. The attacker has disadvantage on the attack roll.

items.name: Water Breathing
entries: The troll can breathe underwater.

trait.name: Standing Leap

Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Severin regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn.

The {@condition entravé} target takes 21 ({@dégât 6d6}) firedgts at the start of each of its turns. At the end of its turns, la cible can make a {@dd 17}Force saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Tiamat can innately cast the following spell, her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 26}):

trait.name: Discorporation
entries: When Tiamat drops to 0touché points or dies, her body is destroyed but her essence travels back to her domain in the Nine Hells, and she is unable to take physical form for a time.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Immunité magique limitée
entries: Unless she wishes to be affected, Tiamat is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Armes magiques
entries: Tiamat's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: Tiamat peut faire one reaction per turn, rather than only one per round. She also avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against being knocked {@condition inconscient}. If she fails a saving throw against an effect that would stun une créature, one of her unspent legendary actions is spent.

trait.name: Régénération
entries: Tiamat regains 30touché points at the start of her turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tiamat can use her Frightful Presence. She then makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her tail.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} pour toucher, allonge 15 m,, une cible. {@h}24 ({@dégât 4d6 + 10}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Tail

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Tiamat's choice that is within 240 mètres of Tiamat and aware of her doit réussir on a {@dd 26}Sagesse saving throw or become {@condition effrayé} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If une créature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, la créature is immune to Tiamat's Frightful Presence for the next 24 heures.

legendaryHeader: Tiamat can take 5 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Tiamat regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

Tiamat's legendary action options are associated with her five dragon heads (a bite and a breath weapon for each). Once Tiamat chooses a legendary action option for one of her heads, she can't choose another one associated with that head until the start of her next turn.
